body: I walk slowly up the steep slope towards the whispering pines at the edge of the forest. Each step burns my feet. My heart races as I hear the soft rustling leaves above me. The air feels charged, alive with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Before long, the trees thicken, and there it stands - the imposing silhouette of the tree that has summoned me this time. Its branches stretch out like an ancient, silent tongue, reaching for something intangible yet powerful. With every gust of wind, small cracks appear on its bark, revealing hidden stories. My curiosity grows until it becomes more than just a desire to know; it’s an urgent call to uncover the truth behind these whispers.
